parts: CH. Big-Foot de Thalek Give Me Five
White and red male born on September 5, 2009. Shoulder height: 25,80 cm. Weith: 7,500 Kg.
PORTUGUESE BEAUTY CHAMPION, INTERNATIONAL CHAMPION, SPANISH BEAUTY CHAMPION
DNA identified with the Real Sociedad Canina de España.
Father DNA identified with the Real Sociedad Canina de España.
From the cross of our Champion Universal Beauty (Chicho) with our female A Lovely Dream (Funny), this dog, who is beautiful in our eyes, was born, and of course he has stayed with us.

Currently being shown, he made his intermediate class debut at the Burdeaux International Show 2011 (in France), at a Tibetan breeds specialty show under breed specialist judge Mr. Laurent Heinesche, winning CACS, CACIB and Best of Breed over 49 dogs entered, then placing 2nd in Group.
He is currently competing in shows.
We are very happy to have bred this little boy in our home.
